chemistry.notes: NMC (EVspecs.org); Rimac states "lithium manganese nickel" 21700 cells.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: 800 V system, max 730 V (InsideEVs; Rimac page max 730 V). Same architecture for the Nevera R (EVspecs.org lists 800 V inverters).

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Rimac: 120 kWh (not labelled gross or usable). EVspecs.org lists 130 kWh gross.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Battery Design: "Usable Energy = 106.8 kWh (120 kWh total)", 89 % SoC window. Conflict: EVspecs.org lists 120 kWh usable / 130 gross.

dc_max_kw.notes: Rimac: 500 kW DC Combo (0-80 % in 19 min); EVspecs.org lists 500 kW for the Nevera R too.
